hint.label: Ground
text: Ground is the past tense of to grind. To grind means to make something into very tiny pieces or to make it into a powder. For example, wheat is ground into flour.

atoms.text: Coffee is one of the most popular drinks in the world. In general, coffee is made out of ground coffee beans and hot water. However, there are several steps that have to happen before someone can drink a cup of coffee.

Before you can brew a cup of coffee, someone first has to grow a coffee tree. Coffee trees grow mainly in warmer climates, for example in Brazil or Ethiopia. After several months, small red coffee cherries hang from the coffee tree. The coffee beans grow inside these coffee cherries. After the harvest, the coffee beans are roasted. Later, the roasted coffee beans are ground. Finally, the ground coffee beans are brewed with hot water to make coffee.

instruction.text: Put the steps of how to make coffee in the correct order.

atoms.b: A coffee tree needs to grow.
Red coffee cherries are harvested for their beans.
The coffee beans are roasted and ground.
Hot water and the ground coffee beans are brewed together.
Now you can pour the coffee into a mug and drink it.
